record.question: Which type of T-cell is distinguished by the presence of a CD4 receptor?
record.explanation: Official final key: B — Helper T-cells. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 7, printed Q5. Source limitation: The source offers both helper and regulatory T cells, and NLM describes regulatory T cells as CD4-positive; the stem does not state a broader phenotype or ask for a predominant class. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
